reglesExercice.consigne: En cas d'erreur, la bonne réponse est montrée puis l'activité est reproposée plus loin dans la séance.

activites.question: What is the Second Conditional? (If + past, would + verb)
reponsesAcceptees: For unreal/hypothetical present situations. Ex: 'If I had money, I would travel.'
activites.explication: For unreal/hypothetical present situations. Ex: 'If I had money, I would travel.'

activites.question: What is the Third Conditional? (If + past perfect, would have + pp)
reponsesAcceptees: For unreal past situations (regrets). Ex: 'If I had studied, I would have passed.'
activites.explication: For unreal past situations (regrets). Ex: 'If I had studied, I would have passed.'

activites.question: Difference between 'will' and 'going to'?
reponsesAcceptees: 'Will' = spontaneous/uncertain. 'Going to' = already planned or evidence-based.
activites.explication: 'Will' = spontaneous/uncertain. 'Going to' = already planned or evidence-based.

activites.question: What is the Future Continuous?
reponsesAcceptees: Will + be + verb-ing. For actions in progress at a future time. Ex: 'At 8pm, I will be studying.'
activites.explication: Will + be + verb-ing. For actions in progress at a future time. Ex: 'At 8pm, I will be studying.'

reglesApprentissage.consigne: L'anglais s'apprend par la production, pas par la mémorisation espacée. L'élève découvre le mot en contexte, le tape, le dit à voix haute, puis le réutilise. Toute réponse incorrecte est reproposée immédiatement dans la même séance, jusqu'à réussite. Aucune carte n'entre dans la file de révision espacée.
